body.title: Compose public contracts and verify packaged handoff
body.summary: Publish complete runtime implementations and schema/type exports from proposed src/workflow/usage/index.ts, then run the public domain-contract fixtures and compiled-output schema smoke checks. Validate the additive migration and sc1/sc2 handoff to later stories.
acceptanceChecks: UsageReducer.validate/reduce and UsageAttributionPolicy.validate match approved HLD/LLD signatures and all six acceptance criteria pass through the public domain surface.

No placeholder implementations, hidden filesystem/provider/DB side effects or sibling service activation remain; immutable source facts and typed effective ownership agree across replay/permutation fixtures.

In a private /tmp fixture containing copied compiled usage/identity modules, package metadata and dependency access but no source tree, production exports load both schemas under the supported Node runtime. Do not move/delete workspace src; schema digests and record round-trips match source fixtures.

Run npm run build, npx tsx --test 'src/workflow/usage/__tests__/*.test.ts' and npx tsx --test src/workflow/__tests__/artifact-ids.test.ts. Report unrelated baseline failures without scope expansion; document no data rewrite and optional-owner compatibility.

tests.name: src/workflow/usage/__tests__/domain-contract.test.ts: complete public domain surface, ownership/basis consistency, replay/permutation and no sibling side effects
src/workflow/usage/__tests__/schema-contract.test.ts: isolated /tmp compiled-output imports with no source tree and matching schema digests
npm run build and the focused src/workflow/usage/__tests__/*.test.ts suite pass or unrelated baseline blockers are explicitly identified
